Madden also described the subsequent fire, which engulfed the car, as one of the "most intense" vehicle fires he had encountered, due largely to the lithium-ion battery cells housed in the undercarriage of the Tesla that Ohain was driving.
Ohain's cause of death was determined to be smoke inhalation and thermal injuries, per the Post, and Madden said he probably would have survived the crash had it not been for the intensity of the flames.
尽管奥海恩在事故发生时处于醉酒状态，血液酒精含量超过法定上限的三倍，但调查人员发现这起事故并非典型的酒驾事故。科罗拉多州巡逻队的罗伯特·马登中士告诉《华盛顿邮报》，现场没有刹车痕迹——如果有刹车痕迹则表明车辆在撞击前曾试图制动——但发现了“滚动轮胎痕迹”，这意味着在撞击后动力仍在向车轮输出。
Nora Bass, Ohain's widow, told the Post her husband believed in [Elon Musk](https://www.businessinsider.com/elon-musk)'s vision for the future of autonomous vehicles so much that he was willing to tolerate the "jerky" experience to help improve Tesla's self-driving technology.
But since Tesla has so far been silent about Ohain's death, she told the outlet she felt she and her husband were "just guinea pigs" ironing out the kinks in the tech with a false promise of safety.
马登说，“考虑到事故的动态特征以及车辆是如何驶出道路且没有突然转向迹象的，这与辅助驾驶功能被启用的情况相符。”
"Regardless of how drunk Hans was, Musk has claimed that this car can drive itself and is essentially better than a human," Bass told the Post. "We were sold a false sense of security."
Bass and representatives for Tesla didn't immediately respond to a request for comment from Business Insider.
马登还描述了随后吞噬整辆汽车的火灾，称这是他见过的“最剧烈”的车辆火灾之一，主要原因是奥海恩驾驶的特斯拉底盘下方装有锂离子电池。
[Tesla's disclaimer](https://www.tesla.com/support/autopilot) for its current self-driving technology reads: "Autopilot, Enhanced Autopilot, and Full Self-Driving Capability are intended for use with a fully attentive driver, who has their hands on the wheel and is prepared to take over at any moment. While these features are designed to become more capable over time, the currently enabled features do not make the vehicle autonomous."
Tesla's Full Self-Driving capability is still in beta testing.
据《华盛顿邮报》报道，奥海恩的死因被确定为吸入烟雾和热损伤，马登表示，如果没有火焰的剧烈程度，他很可能在撞击中幸存下来。
There have been numerous crashes, some fatal, linked to Tesla's Autopilot technology, which is designed for use on highways, though Tesla has not been found [responsible for the crashes](https://www.businessinsider.com/tesla-autopilot-not-responsible-fatal-crash-jury-finds-elon-musk-2023-11).
But the Full Self-Driving technology --- meant to maneuver Tesla vehicles through nearly any scenario --- has not been definitively tied to any deaths. The Post reported that a Tesla driver who was behind an eight-car pileup causing multiple injuries on the San Francisco-Oakland Bay Bridge in November 2022 said he was using [Full Self-Driving](https://www.businessinsider.com/tesla-crashes-involving-autopilot-mode-soar-since-2019-report-finds-2023-6) and that Ohain's death could be the first known fatality associated with the technology.
奥海恩的遗孀诺拉·巴斯告诉《华盛顿邮报》，她的丈夫非常相信埃隆·马斯克对自动驾驶汽车未来的愿景，以至于他愿意忍受“颠簸”的体验来帮助改进特斯拉的自动驾驶技术。
Document 3454: Tesla Sold ‘False Sense Of Security’ To Employee Killed In Suspected Full Self-Driving Crash
Tesla's [Full Self-Driving software can't drive your car](https://jalopnik.com/tesla-s-self-driving-ambitions-are-further-and-further-1850245462) by itself. Despite its name, the advanced driver assist program [requires drivers keep their eyes on the road](https://jalopnik.com/elon-musk-says-version-12-of-so-called-full-self-drivin-1850586856) at all times and be prepared to [take the wheel at a moment's notice](https://jalopnik.com/americans-are-starting-to-realize-self-driving-cars-are-1851231139). Now, the widow of a driver killed in a crash that involved FSD has accused the automaker of selling a "false sense of security" with the software.
特斯拉的完全自动驾驶软件并不能自动驾驶您的汽车。尽管其名称如此，这个高级驾驶辅助程序要求驾驶员始终注视道路，并随时准备接管方向盘。如今，在一起涉及完全自动驾驶的事故中遇难的驾驶员遗孀，指控这家汽车制造商通过该软件销售了一种“虚假的安全感”。
In 2022, Tesla employee Hans von Ohain was driving his Model 3 electric vehicle alongside Erik Rossiter.受影响方 The pair had been out playing golf one afternoon and had a few drinks before heading home. On the drive back, von Ohain reportedly let his Tesla take control of the ride by initiating its FSD software, [reports the *Washington Post*](https://www.washingtonpost.com/technology/interactive/2024/tesla-full-self-driving-fatal-crash/).
However, the drive ended in disaster [when the Model 3](https://jalopnik.com/tesla-model-3-finally-gets-feature-other-cars-have-had-1850826500) careered off the road and burst into flames, killing von Ohain and injuring Rossiter. As the *Post* explains:
2022年，特斯拉员工汉斯·冯·欧海因驾驶着他的Model 3电动汽车，载着埃里克·罗西特。当天下午，两人外出打高尔夫球后，在回家路上喝了几杯。据报道，在返程途中，冯·欧海因启动了完全自动驾驶软件，让他的特斯拉接管了驾驶。
> "The Tesla Model 3 barreled into a tree and exploded in flames, killing von Ohain, a Tesla employee and devoted fan of CEO Elon Musk. Rossiter, who survived the crash, told emergency responders that von Ohain was using an "auto-drive feature on the Tesla" that "just ran straight off the road," according to a 911 dispatch recording obtained by The Washington Post. In a recent interview, Rossiter said he believes that von Ohain was using Full Self-Driving, which --- if true --- would make his death the first known fatality involving Tesla's most advanced driver-assistance technology."
While no crash has so far been definitively linked to the FSD program, the *Post* identified numerous other collisions in which drivers claimed the software was initiated. This included a 2022 crash that [caused a massive pileup in San Francisco](https://jalopnik.com/tesla-in-full-self-driving-mode-caused-8-car-pile-up-r-1849922546) and at least [two serious crashes](https://jalopnik.com/tesla-confirm-automated-driving-engaged-fatal-crash-1850347917), including the crash that killed von Ohain.
然而，当这辆Model 3冲出道路并起火燃烧时，这段旅程以灾难告终，冯·欧海因不幸遇难，罗西特受伤。正如《华盛顿邮报》所解释的：
Von Ohain's crash is complicated, though, as a postmortem following his death revealed that he was three times over the legal blood alcohol limit to drive. Still, police investigating the crash have sought to uncover [the role FSD played](https://jalopnik.com/teslas-promise-of-a-fully-self-driving-car-merely-an-as-1849887546) in von Ohain's death. The *Post* reports:
> Von Ohain's widow, Nora Bass, said she has been unable to find a lawyer willing to take his case to court because he was legally intoxicated. Nonetheless, she said, Tesla should take at least some responsibility for her husband's death.
“特斯拉Model 3撞上一棵树后起火爆炸，冯·欧海因当场死亡，他是特斯拉员工兼首席执行官埃里克·马斯克的忠实粉丝。罗西特在事故中幸存，他告诉紧急救援人员，冯·欧海因当时在使用特斯拉的'自动驾驶功能'，'直接冲出了道路'。根据《华盛顿邮报》获取的911调度录音，在最近的一次采访中，罗西特表示，他认为冯·欧海因当时正在使用完全自动驾驶，如果属实，这将是已知的第一起涉及特斯拉最先进驾驶辅助技术的致命事故。”
>
> "Regardless of how drunk Hans was, Musk has claimed that this car can drive itself and is essentially better than a human," Bass said. "We were sold a false sense of security."
尽管目前没有一起事故被明确认定与完全自动驾驶程序有关，但《华盛顿邮报》发现了多起其他碰撞事故，驾驶员声称当时已启动了完全自动驾驶软件。其中包括2022年在旧金山造成大规模连环撞车的事故，以及至少两起严重碰撞事故，包括导致冯·欧海因遇难的那起事故。
In the aftermath of the crash, investigators found that the [Tesla continued](https://jalopnik.com/tesla-alerted-driver-150-times-to-take-the-wheel-before-1850724778) to feed power to the wheels after impact. They also didn't identify any signs that Von Ohain nor the car itself had applied the brakes to try and stop the Model 3 as it came off the road. This, Colorado State Patrol Sgt. Robert Madden told the *Post, *was a clear sign that "fits with the [driver-assistance] feature being engaged."
Due to the intensity of the fire and the destruction of the car that it cause, Colorado investigators have been unable to access data from the car to [determine if FSD really was engaged](https://jalopnik.com/elon-musk-tesla-self-driving-cars-anniversary-autopilot-1850432357). What's more, Tesla said that it "...could not confirm that a driver-assistance system had been in use because it did not receive data over-the-air for this incident," reports the *Post*.
不过，冯·欧海因的事故情况较为复杂，因为验尸显示，他的血液酒精浓度是法定驾驶上限的三倍。然而，负责调查这起事故的警方仍试图查明完全自动驾驶在他死亡中所起的作用。《华盛顿邮报》报道：
Tesla did report the crash to the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration as part of its continued reporting of crashes involving its [Autopilot and FSD systems](https://jalopnik.com/elon-musk-tesla-self-driving-demo-was-a-mess-1850783574). However, NHTSA could not confirm which program was involved in the crash.
Document 3459: Tesla Recruiter's Tragic Death in Colorado Crash Raises Questions About EV's Full Self-Driving Feature
A Tesla recruiter lost his life in a tragic incident in 2022 while using the electric vehicle's (EV) Full Self-Driving (FSD) feature. The fatal accident occurred on a Colorado mountain road when Hans von Ohain's Tesla Model 3 veered off the road, collided with a tree, and subsequently caught fire.
2022年，一名特斯拉招聘人员在使用电动汽车完全自动驾驶（FSD）功能时遭遇悲剧事故丧生。这起致命事故发生在科罗拉多州一条山间公路上，汉斯·冯·奥拜恩的特斯拉Model 3偏离道路，撞上一棵树，随后起火。
Surviving passenger and friend Erik Rossiter informed emergency responders that the victim had activated the "auto-drive feature" before the crash. In a report, The Washington Post wrote that this would be Tesla's first driver-assistance fatality if the incident gets [officially connected with FSD. ](https://www.washingtonpost.com/technology/interactive/2024/tesla-full-self-driving-fatal-crash/)Even though von Ohain was legally drunk, officials are investigating Tesla's software's participation in the disaster.
Tesla Driver-Assistance Features Under Scrutiny
幸存乘客兼朋友埃里克·罗西特告诉急救人员，受害者在撞车前已启用"自动驾驶功能"。《华盛顿邮报》在一篇报道中写道，如果该事件与FSD正式关联，这将成为特斯拉首例辅助驾驶致死事故。尽管冯·奥拜恩处于法定醉驾状态，官员们仍在调查特斯拉软件在这场灾难中是否发挥了作用。
-----------------------------------------------
Since 2021, federal officials have recorded over 900 Tesla driver-assistance system crashes, with at least 40 causing serious or fatal injuries. The majority included Tesla's Autopilot, meant for highway use, although full self-driving, intended for more situations, has not been related to any fatalities.
特斯拉驾驶辅助功能受到审查
Tesla calls FSD "beta" but highlights its importance for road safety after releasing it to 400,000 customers.风险源 Tesla user guides listed scenarios where FSD may not work, and the EV manufacturer emphasizes driver control. The reported Tesla accidents cast doubt on autonomous driving and driver-assistance technology safety, emphasizing regulatory attention and the necessity to comprehend changing technology on public roadways.
-----------------------------------------------
Though Tesla has not yet commented on the issue, it warns that Autopilot, Enhanced Autopilot, and Full Self-Driving Capability are designed to be utilized by a fully aware driver, grasping the wheel and r[eady to take control ](https://www.businessinsider.com/tesla-employee-died-full-self-driving-fatal-crash-2024-2)at any time, according to Business Insider. "While these features are designed to become more capable over time, the currently enabled features do not make the vehicle autonomous," Tesla stated.
Is Tesla Deceiving The Public with FSD?
自2021年以来，联邦官员已记录了超过900起特斯拉驾驶辅助系统事故，其中至少40起造成严重或致命伤害。大多数涉及特斯拉的高速公路用自动辅助驾驶系统Autopilot，尽管旨在应对更多场景的完全自动驾驶功能此前尚未与任何致死事故相关联。
---------------------------------------
Hans von Ohain, a Marine veteran and Tesla employee since 2020, was a believer in the potential of Tesla's full self-driving technology and frequently utilized the feature. Given Elon Musk's claims about the technology's capabilities, his widow, Nora Bass, expressed worries about the false sense of security FSD provides, per The Post.
特斯拉称FSD为"测试版"，但在向40万客户发布后强调其对道路安全的重要性。特斯拉用户指南列出了FSD可能无法工作的场景，这家电动汽车制造商强调驾驶员控制。报道的特斯拉事故对自动驾驶和驾驶辅助技术安全性提出了质疑，强调了监管关注以及理解公共道路上不断发展的技术的必要性。
Bass highlighted her struggle to secure legal representation due to her husband's state of intoxication. However, she maintained that Tesla shares some responsibility for her spouse's demise, emphasizing that regardless of Hans's level of intoxication, Musk claimed that the car could operate autonomously and was essentially superior to a human. "We were sold a false sense of security."
Tesla's self-driving claims are under investigation by the government. Despite Elon Musk's [frequent promises](https://www.theverge.com/2023/8/23/23837598/tesla-elon-musk-self-driving-false-promises-land-of-the-giants) regarding autonomous vehicles, Tesla's history is now tainted by the FSD tragedies. One of multiple Tesla lawsuits is led by Nabilah Hussain, a lawyer alleging that the EV firm advertised a non-existent fully self-driving device. "Tesla is marketing and trying to sell you a product that doesn't exist," Hussain said in the article.
尽管特斯拉尚未就此问题发表评论，但据《商业内幕》报道，该公司警告称，自动辅助驾驶、增强版自动辅助驾驶和完全自动驾驶功能仅供完全警觉的驾驶员使用，需手握方向盘并随时准备接管。"虽然这些功能旨在随着时间推移变得更加强大，但当前启用的功能并不能使车辆实现自动驾驶，"特斯拉表示。
Tesla has not officially recognized von Ohain's death, raising issues about the company's duty and contact with employees and their families. The incident highlights persistent technical and ethical concerns around incorporating autonomous driving technology into daily use.

Document 2502: Vanderbilt University uses ChatGPT to address MSU shooting: ‘Sick’
Tennessee’s Vanderbilt University apologized after it used ChatGPT to write a nonsensical email addressing the deadly Michigan State University shooting — which students have blasted as “twisted.”
田纳西州范德堡大学在使用ChatGPT撰写了一封关于密歇根州立大学枪击案的毫无意义的邮件后道歉，学生们痛批这封邮件“令人恶心”。
The bizarre email, sent out Thursday by the Nashville institution’s Peabody Office of Equity, Diversity and Inclusion, made no mention of Vanderbilt-specific resources students could contact for support — and instead included several repetitive paragraphs offering vague thoughts about “creating a safe and inclusive environment.”
It also refers to “recent Michigan shootings,” when there was only one incident, according to the Vanderbilt Hustler, [which first reported the story](https://vanderbilthustler.com/2023/02/17/peabody-edi-office-responds-to-msu-shooting-with-email-written-using-chatgpt/).
这封奇怪的邮件于周四由该校位于纳什维尔的皮博迪公平、多元与包容办公室发出，邮件中没有提及任何范德堡大学学生可以联系的支持资源，而是包含了几段重复的内容，表达了一些关于“创造安全包容环境”的模糊想法。
At the bottom of the email — in much smaller type — a line reads “Paraphrase from OpenAI’s ChatGPT AI language model, personal communication, February 15, 2023.”
Laith Kayat, a senior at Vanderbilt who is from Michigan and has a younger sister who attends MSU, told the student newspaper it was impersonal and lacked empathy.
邮件中还提到了“最近密歇根州的枪击事件”，但实际上只有一起事件。据范德堡大学校报《Vanderbilt Hustler》最先报道了这一事件。
“There’s a sick and twisted irony to making a computer write your message about community and togetherness because you can’t be bothered to reflect on it yourself,” Kayat said.
“\\[Administrators\\] only care about perception and their institutional politics of saving face.”
邮件底部以小得多的字体写着：“改编自OpenAI的ChatGPT AI语言模型，个人交流，2023年2月15日。”
Samuel Lu, a sophomore, told the paper he felt that using ChatGPT was disrespectful to gun violence victims.受影响方
“It’s hard to take a message seriously when I know that the sender didn’t even take the time to put their genuine thoughts and feelings into words,” Lu said. “In times of tragedies such as this, we need more, not less humanity.”
范德堡大学高年级学生莱恩·卡亚特来自密歇根州，他的妹妹在密歇根州立大学就读。他告诉校报，这封邮件缺乏人情味，没有同理心。
Nicole Joseph, the associate dean for the Office of Equity, Diversity and Inclusion, said the decision to use ChatGPT to write the email was made in “poor judgment.”
“While we believe in the message of inclusivity expressed in the email, using ChatGPT to generate communications on behalf of our community in a time of sorrow and in response to a tragedy contradicts the values that characterize Peabody College,” Joseph apologized in a follow-up email.
卡亚特说：“用电脑来写关于社区和团结的信息，因为你们懒得自己去思考，这真是种病态而扭曲的讽刺。”
“As with all new technologies that affect higher education, this moment gives us all an opportunity to reflect on what we know and what we still must learn about AI.”
[In a statement,](https://peabody.vanderbilt.edu/statement.php) Peabody College’s dean of education and human development, Camilla P. Benbow, said her office is reviewing what happened.
“【管理人员】只在乎表面形象和他们维护面子的机构政治。”
Both Joseph and assistant dean Hasina Mohyuddin will step back from their work in the meantime.
Benbow noted that the development and distribution of the initial email did not follow the school’s normal protocols, which generally include multiple layers of review before being sent.
大二学生塞缪尔·卢告诉校报，他认为使用ChatGPT对枪击案受害者是不尊重的。
“The university’s administrators, including myself, were unaware of the email before it was sent,” Benbow wrote.
“I am also deeply troubled that a communication from my administration so missed the crucial need for personal connection and empathy during a time of tragedy,” Benbow continued.
卢说：“当我得知发送者甚至没有花时间将自己的真实想法和感受表达出来时，很难认真对待这样的信息。在这样的悲剧时刻，我们需要更多的而不是更少的人文关怀。”
“I intend that we shall redouble our efforts to express the values that animate our mission and lead to human flourishing. And I offer my heartfelt apologies to all those who deserved better from us and did not receive it.”
Document 2504: Vanderbilt staff used ChatGPT to write email to students about MSU shooting
[Vanderbilt University](/topic/vanderbilt-university) staff have apologized for using [ChatGPT](/topic/chatgpt) to write a condolence email in the wake of the [Michigan State University](/topic/michigan-state-university) shooting that saw three students murdered.
范德堡大学工作人员已就使用ChatGPT撰写慰问邮件一事道歉，此前密歇根州立大学发生枪击事件，造成三名学生遇害。
Officials at the Office of Equity, Diversity and Inclusion at Peabody College admitted “poor judgement” in using the OpenAI chatbot for the email.
“The recent [Michigan](/topic/michigan) shootings are a tragic reminder of the importance of taking care of each other, particularly in the context of creating inclusive environments,” [read the initial email](https://vanderbilthustler.com/2023/02/17/peabody-edi-office-responds-to-msu-shooting-with-email-written-using-chatgpt/) from the university’s school of education.
皮博迪学院多元化与包容事务办公室的官员承认，使用OpenAI聊天机器人撰写邮件是“判断失误”。
And it added: “As members of the Peabody campus community, we must reflect on the impact of such an event and take steps to ensure that we are doing our best to create a safe and inclusive environment for all.”
At the bottom of the email was a note stating, “Paraphrase from OpenAI’s ChatGPT.” ChatGPT is an AI language model that writes human-sounding but computer-generated text.
这封来自该校教育学院的邮件写道：“近期密歇根州的枪击事件悲惨地提醒我们，彼此关爱的重要性，尤其是在创建包容性环境方面。”
The email brought an angry response from students at the Nashville-based university.
“There is a sick and twisted irony to making a computer write your message about community and togetherness because you can’t be bothered to reflect on it yourself,” Laith Kayat, a senior student whose sister attends Michigan State University, [told _The Vanderbilt Hustler_.](https://vanderbilthustler.com/2023/02/17/peabody-edi-office-responds-to-msu-shooting-with-email-written-using-chatgpt/)

据范德堡大学学生报纸《范德堡 Hustler》报道，该校大四学生莱思·卡亚特（其妹妹在密歇根州立大学就读）称使用ChatGPT的做法"令人恶心"。
"I am also deeply troubled that a communication from my administration so missed the crucial need for personal connection and empathy during a time of tragedy," she added in her statement.
Poor judgment
卡亚特告诉《Hustler》："让一台电脑替你写关于社区和团结的消息，因为你懒得自己去思考，这有一种病态且扭曲的讽刺。""管理人员只在乎形象和他们保全面子的机构政治。"
-------------
There are scenarios in which ChatGPT can be [highly effective at drafting communications](https://www.cbsnews.com/news/chatgpt-work-real-estate-finance-health-care-how-workers-use-it-jobs/). Some chief executives have come to rely on the tool to write speeches and act as a "thought partner." ChatGPT can summarize data and generate text, but doesn't possess the emotional intelligence of humans, according to Columbia Business School professor Oded Netzer. Understanding the "why" behind facts and figures and expressing genuine emotion are still "the types of tasks that require judgment and that humans are still very valuable in," he said.

Document 483: This employee was fired by a machine and there's nothing his manager could do about it
'The Machine Fired Me' -- a blog post by Ibrahim Diallo speaks of exactly what it is titled. Diallo was literally fired by a machine one fine day. He realised it after his security pass stopped working, his computer system login was disabled, and finally he was hustled from the building by security personnel. He hopes that his detailed story in his blog will serve as a warning to firms about relying too much on automation.
“机器解雇了我”——易卜拉欣·迪亚洛（Ibrahim Diallo）的一篇博文讲述的正是标题所言之事。迪亚洛确实在某一天被一台机器解雇了。在他的安保通行证失效、计算机系统登录被禁用，最后被安保人员带离大楼后，他意识到了这一点。他希望他在博客中详述的故事能给那些过度依赖自动化的公司敲响警钟。
Diallo's firing
After having to enter his office with the help of his security guard, failing to log in to his computer, and a long wait, he was told by his recruiter that she had received an email saying his contract was terminated.
迪亚洛被解雇
She promised to sort out the problem.
As Diallo entered his Los Angeles office the next day, he'd been locked out of every single system "except my Linux machine" and then, after lunch, two people appeared at his desk to inform him that an email had been received telling them to escort him from the building.
在不得不依靠安保人员帮忙进入办公室、无法登录电脑，以及漫长的等待之后，招聘人员告诉他，她收到一封电子邮件，称他的合同已被终止。
Diallo's manager couldn't do anything about it
Ibrahim's boss was confused but helpless.
她承诺会解决这个问题。
I was fired. There was nothing my manager could do about it. There was nothing the director could do about it.
Adding to the uncontrollable situation, Diallo writes: "They stood powerless as I packed my stuff and left the building".
第二天，当迪亚洛走进他的洛杉矶办公室时，他已被锁出了所有系统，“除了我的Linux机器”，然后，午饭后，两个人出现在他的桌旁，通知他收到一封电子邮件，要求将他带离大楼。
"I watched it be escalated to bigger and more powerful titles over and over, yet no-one could do anything about it."
"From time-to-time, they would attach a system email," he laments.
迪亚洛的经理对此无能为力
System-generated e-mail sent to Ibrahim instructing his termination. (Courtesy: Ibrahim Diallo's blog)
At the time that he was fired, he was eight months into a three-year contract and over the next three weeks he was copied into emails about his case.
易卜拉欣的老板感到困惑却又无能为力。
"It was soulless and written in red as it gave orders that dictated my fate. Disable this, disable that, revoke access here, revoke access there, escort out of premises, etc," writes Ibrahim on the ruthlessness of the system.
The system was out for blood and I was its very first victim
我被解雇了。我的经理对此无能为力。总监对此也无能为力。
Why did the machine fire him after all?
A three weeks' time is what it took Ibrahim's bosses to really figure why he had been fired.
迪亚洛写道：“当我收拾东西离开大楼时，他们无能为力地站在一旁”，这让不可控的局面更加糟糕。

令人难以置信的是，花了三周时间才解决这个问题，让“未被解雇”的迪亚洛回到办公桌前。有趣的是，他当时决定辞职，带着他的专业技能另谋高就。到底发生了什么？
"Who the hell is sending those emails!?" he bellowed as HAL 9000 looked on without emotion. For it was HAL – or, at least his version of it – that was behind the situation, it was eventually discovered. But it was weeks of no work before that came out.
Transition
根据迪亚洛本周发布的一篇博文所述，其实没人知道。他只知道有一天他的门禁卡失效了，导致他不得不尴尬地向安保人员求助，并领取了一系列临时通行证。
"Just before I was hired, this company was acquired by a much larger company and I joined during the transition," Diallo explained. "My manager at the time was from the previous administration.
"One morning I came to work to see that his desk had been wiped clean, as if he was disappeared. As a full time employee, he had been laid off. He was to work from home as a contractor for the duration of a transition. I imagine due to the shock and frustration, he decided not to do much work after that. Some of that work included renewing my contract in the new system."
这种遭遇我们都能感同身受。但紧接着，他开始接到招聘人员的电话，问他为什么被解雇了。他去找经理，经理向他保证他还有工作——毕竟他那份三年的合同才签了八个月——但他慢慢发现自己被挡在了所有工作所需的系统之外。
Robot Romeo gets its 'antenna' snapped off in attempt to 'charm' testy American READ MORE
As it turned out, some time-saving sysadmin had written a script to automatically shut out an employee with the trigger being the official employee termination email.风险源
经理一直坚持让他来上班，直到有一天——在一封措辞严厉的邮件指示下——安保人员出现并将他护送出了大楼。
The automation extended to the point that the non-renewal of the contract – requiring human intervention – led to the termination email, which led to that employee's key card being disabled, and their network access cut off on each system that they had privileges on.
What about the email ordering security to escort him from the building? That was seemingly triggered by him trying to use his cancelled key card to get into the building. Another script red-flagged the attempted unauthorized entry and alerted security. When he then tried to log in to his blocked accounts, well…
“到底是谁发的这些邮件！？”他怒吼道，而HAL 9000在一旁冷眼旁观。最终发现，正是HAL——或者至少是它的某个版本——造成了这一局面。但在真相大白之前，他已经数周无法工作。
The system was also impervious to efforts to stop the process, no matter how high up the issue went. In the end, the company gave up and Diallo had to be rehired as a completely new employee, with all his details re-entered – including bank details - and his network privileges recreated from scratch. A new key card had to be ordered.
"What I called job security was only an illusion," he writes nervously. "I couldn't help but imagine what would have happened if I had actually made a mistake in this company. Automation can be an asset to a company, but there needs to be a way for humans to take over if the machine makes a mistake. I missed three weeks of pay because no one could stop the machine."
过渡期
Oh we know
Of course what he doesn't know but we suggest is that this was no machine at work – at least not one working autonomously.
“就在我被录用之前，这家公司被一家大得多的公司收购了，我是在过渡期间加入的，”迪亚洛解释道。“我当时的经理属于前任管理层。
Somewhere out there is a Bastard Operator from Hell who knows exactly what happened. We imagine he is currently reclining on a Caribbean beach, checking every once in a while that everything is up and that the system continues to be prompted to make it look as though he is entering the building at night and leaving again in the morning.
No one sees him and they dare not ask him questions. No one has opened his door in years and that's how he likes it. We take out hat off to you, sir. ®
“一天早上我来上班，发现他的桌子被清理得干干净净，就像人间蒸发了一样。作为一名全职员工，他被裁员了。在过渡期间，他将以承包商的身份在家办公。我想是由于震惊和沮丧，他之后决定不怎么干活了。那些未完成的工作中就包括在新系统中续签我的合同。”

A facial recognition system in Ningbo mistakenly identified an advertisement featuring Dong Mingzhu, chair of Gree Electric, as the actual person and charged her with jaywalking.受影响方 The police later acknowledged the error and stated they would upgrade their technology.

Document 5070: Chinese facial recognition system mistakes a face on a bus for a jaywalker
Chinese facial recognition system mistakes a face on a bus for a jaywalker
中国人脸识别系统误将公交车上的头像认作闯红灯者
China’s facial recognition systems are used to catch all types of criminals, from thieves to jaywalkers, in real time. This week, one facial recognition camera publicly shamed a famous business woman for jaywalking after its systems caught her face crossing an intersection. The problem? She was never physically there.
中国的人脸识别系统正被用于实时抓捕各类违法犯罪人员，从小偷到闯红灯者无一遗漏。本周，一套人脸识别摄像头公开“羞辱”了一位著名的女商人，称其闯红灯，因为系统捕捉到了她的面孔正在通过路口。然而问题在于，她本人当时并不在现场。
As first reported by Abacus, it all took place in the Zhejiang province, south of Shanghai. The face of Dong Mingzhu, a president of China’s top air-conditioning company, flashed on a large screen displayed to the public listing nearby jaywalkers caught by cameras. A line of text captioned her photo, saying she had broken the law. It also listed part of her government ID number and her name, but misidentified her surname as “Ju.”
But what the camera actually saw was an ad featuring Dong’s face on the side of a bus. Local police soon admitted in a statement on microblogging site Weibo that identifying Dong as a jaywalker was an error made by the facial recognition system, and claimed that the problem had now been fixed by an upgrade.风险控制
据 Abacus 首先报道，这一事件发生在上海南部的浙江省。董明珠——中国顶尖空调公司的董事长——的面孔出现在一块向公众展示的大屏幕上，该屏幕用于公示被摄像头抓拍到的附近闯红灯者。一行文字说明配在她的照片旁，指出她违反了法律。屏幕上还列出了她部分政府身份证号码和姓名，但误将她的姓氏错标为“居”。
Dong Mingzhu made first place on the Forbes list of the top 100 outstanding businesswomen in China last year and has made headlines for having never taken a day off in 26 years, at the cost of her personal life. A photo of the display screen has gone viral on Weibo, as people pointed out that despite the hype surrounding facial recognition, it turned out the system could still make mistakes. “Be careful of being sued by Dong Mingzhu,” one netizen mocked.
Chinese traffic police have increasingly relied on facial recognition systems to catch those who violate the rules. The systems have come to major cities like Beijing, Shanghai, and Shenzhen, and have captured tens of thousands of jaywalkers since installation. Officials have also talked to WeChat and Weibo about potentially fining offenders via text messages. While the systems are often a talking point for officials discussing their accomplishments and work to bring down crime, but as this incident proves, the systems still aren’t infallible.
但实际上，摄像头拍到的只是公交车车身广告上董明珠的头像。当地警方很快在微博上发布声明承认，将董明珠认定为闯红灯者是人脸识别系统的误判，并声称该问题已通过系统升级得到修复。

Document 513: Facial recognition system in China mistakes bus ad for jaywalker
A system deployed by the Chinese government to identify jaywalkers, reportedly using real-time facial recognition, has mistakenly identified a celebrity as an offender after scanning her face from an advertisement on the side of a passing bus, Chinese tech website Abacus reports. Famous businesswoman Dong Mingzhu, who chairs China’s largest air conditioner manufacturing company, was misidentified as a jaywalker at an intersection in Ningbo in eastern China, calling into question the technology’s accuracy and liveness detection capabilities.风险源
据中国科技网站Abacus报道，中国政府部署了一套用于识别乱穿马路者的系统，据报道该系统使用了实时面部识别技术，但在扫描一辆经过的公交车车身广告上的面孔后，错误地将一位名人识别为违规者。著名女商人董明珠是中国最大的空调制造公司的董事长，她在华东宁波的一个路口被误识别为乱穿马路者，这引发了人们对该技术准确性及活体检测能力的质疑。
City traffic police noted the mistake on Weibo, saying that the system had been upgraded to prevent a repeat of the error.
The system has been deployed to many intersections in Shenzhen for months. The systems vary between jurisdictions, with some displaying partial names and ID numbers along with the faces of identified offenders on large screens. Abacus reports that 14,000 jaywalkers have been identified at a single intersection in Shenzhen over a 10-month period, and that Ningbo said 7,800 offenders had been identified at six intersections in the city by June of this year.
城市交警在微博上注意到了这一错误，并表示系统已升级以防止此类错误再次发生。
Not only was Dong wrongly identified as a jaywalker, her face appeared with the surname “Ju,” suggesting that it also mistook her for another individual.
Several companies, such as Dahua, have been working to upgrade the performance of their smart city systems, as China seeks to leverage urban security networks that the New York Times has reported include 200 million surveillance cameras. CNET also reported recently that Chinese authorities have been using gait recognition for public surveillance in Beijing and Shanghai.
该系统已在深圳的多个路口部署数月。不同辖区的系统有所不同，有些会在大屏幕上显示被识别违规者的面部，以及部分姓名和身份证号码。Abacus报道称，在深圳的一个路口，10个月内识别出1.4万名乱穿马路者；宁波方面表示，截至今年6月，该市6个路口已识别出7800名违规者。
Article Topics
biometrics | China | facial recognition | liveness detection | privacy | surveillance

Document 1222: AI chatbot mired in legal dispute over data collection
Artificial intelligence-based chatbot Lee Luda, which ended this month in ethical and data collection controversy, faces lawsuits on charges of violating personal information.
因伦理和数据收集争议于本月停服的人工智能聊天机器人“李鲁达”，因涉嫌侵犯个人信息而面临诉讼。
On Friday, around 400 people filed a class action suit against the creator of the chatbot, Seoul-based startup Scatter Lab, claiming their personal information was leaked in the process of developing and providing the service.
Launched on Dec. 23, Lee Luda, an AI chatbot service designed to imitate a 20-year-old college student, instantly drew over 400,000 users with its ability to communicate in a human-like manner. But the service ended only a week later, after numerous issues were raised with the bot, such as discriminatory expressions, personal information protection and artificial intelligence ethics.
周五，约400人向该聊天机器人的开发者、位于首尔的初创公司Scatter Lab提起集体诉讼，声称他们的个人信息在开发和提供服务的过程中被泄露。
“We will close the applications (today) and review later whether to collect additional victims,” Taerim, the law firm representing the victims, said Friday
The defendants submitted an application for preservation of evidence against Scatterlab with the Seoul Eastern District Court the day before. They asked the court to ensure that Scatter Lab preserved the database built using users’ KakaoTalk conversations as evidence for their case.
“李鲁达”是一款旨在模仿20岁大学生的人工智能聊天机器人服务，于12月23日推出，凭借其类人的交流能力迅速吸引了超过40万用户。但在推出仅一周后，该服务便因存在歧视性表达、个人信息保护和人工智能伦理等诸多问题而停摆。
Scatter Lab collected KakaoTalk conversations of users through its relationship analysis apps Science of Love and Text At to create Lee Luda. After collecting about 10 billion KakaoTalk conversations, 100 million of them are thought to have been collected and used in Lee Luda’s database.
The government organizations -- the Personal Information Protection Committee and the Korea Internet & Security Agency -- are also separately investigating whether the service violated the personal information protection law.风险控制
代表受害者的法律事务所Taerim周五表示：“我们（今天）将停止受理申请，稍后会审查是否继续征集更多受害者。”
A day earlier, civic groups, People’s Solidarity for Participatory Democracy, Korean Progressive Network Center and Lawyers for Democratic Society, filed a complaint with the Personal Information Protection Committee, calling for a thorough investigation of Scatter Lab.
They said they suspected that the startup did not go through appropriate legal procedures for service users, and used data collected to an extent beyond what users agreed to.
原告前一天向首尔东部地方法院提交了针对Scatter Lab的证据保全申请。他们请求法院确保Scatter Lab保存利用用户KakaoTalk对话构建的数据库，作为案件的证据。
The civic groups blamed the current government, saying it only “emphasized fostering the ‘big data industry,’ and pushed for revision of the law.”
They added that “In the process, the rights of information subjects were thoroughly treated as ‘incidental damage.’”
Scatter Lab通过其关系分析应用“爱的科学”和“Text At”收集用户的KakaoTalk对话，以此创建“李鲁达”。在收集了约100亿条KakaoTalk对话后，估计其中有1亿条被收集并用于“李鲁达”的数据库。
“Even now, we need to overhaul the relevant legislation to prevent further damage.”
Document 1230: (2nd LD) Developer of AI chatbot service fined for massive personal data breach
SEOUL, April 28 (Yonhap) -- South Korea's data protection watchdog on Wednesday imposed a hefty monetary penalty on a startup for leaking a massive amount of personal information in the process of developing and commercializing a controversial female chatbot.
首尔4月28日（韩联社）——韩国数据保护监管机构周三对一家初创公司处以巨额罚款，原因是该公司在开发和商业化一款备受争议的女性聊天机器人过程中泄露了大量个人信息。
The Personal Information Protection Commission (PIPC) said Scatter Lab, a Seoul-based startup, was ordered to pay 103.3 million won (US$92,900) in penalties -- a penalty surcharge of 55.5 million won and an administrative fine of 47.8 million won -- for illegally using personal information of its clients in the development and operation of its artificial intelligence-driven chatbot service called "Lee Luda."
It is the first time in South Korea that the government has sanctioned the indiscriminate use of personal information by companies using AI technology.
个人信息保护委员会（PIPC）表示，首尔初创公司Scatter Lab因在开发和运营名为“Lee Luda”的人工智能聊天机器人服务中非法使用客户个人信息，被责令支付1.033亿韩元（约合9.29万美元）的罚款，其中包括5550万韩元的罚金和4780万韩元的行政罚款。
Scatter Lab is accused of using about 600,000 people's 9.4 billion KakaoTalk conversations collected from its emotional analysis apps Science of Love and Text At in the process of developing and operating the Lee Luda chatbot service without obtaining their prior consent.
The company is also criticized for failing to delete or encode the app users' names, mobile phone numbers and personal addresses before using them in the development of its AI chatbot learning algorithms.
这是韩国政府首次对企业在使用人工智能技术过程中无差别使用个人信息的行为进行制裁。
In addition, the Lee Luda chatbot was programmed to select and speak one of about 100 million KakaoTalk conversation sentences from women in their 20s, the PIPC said.
Scatter Lab said it takes full responsibility and is taking steps to prevent recurrence.
Scatter Lab被指控在开发和运营“Lee Luda”聊天机器人服务过程中，未经用户事先同意，使用了从其情感分析应用“Science of Love”和“Text At”中收集的约60万人的94亿条KakaoTalk对话数据。
"We feel a heavy sense of social responsibility as an AI tech company over the necessity to engage in proper personal information processing in the course of developing related technologies and services," the company said in a press release late Wednesday.
"Upon the PIPC's decision, we will not only actively implement the corrective actions put forth by the PIPC but also work to comply with the law and industry guidelines related to personal information processing," the company said.
该公司还因在用于开发AI聊天机器人学习算法之前，未删除或加密应用用户的姓名、手机号码和个人地址而受到批评。
To prevent this from happening again, the company said it is taking various measures under more stringent standards, including the work to restrict services for minors under the age of 14 and other upgrades to enhance protection of personal data.
The Lee Luda chatbot service attracted more than 750,000 users in just three weeks after its launch on Dec. 23, but Scatter Lab suspended the Facebook-based service the following month amid complaints over its discriminatory and offensive language against sexual minorities.
此外，PIPC指出，“Lee Luda”聊天机器人的程序设定是从约1亿条来自20多岁女性的KakaoTalk对话句子中选择并输出一句话。
The PIPC said Scatter Lab has used personal information collected from its Science of Love and Text At apps beyond the purpose of the collection.
The company is also accused of collecting personal information of about 200,000 children under the age of 14 without obtaining the consent of their parents or guardians in the development and operation process for its services.
Scatter Lab表示承担全部责任，并正在采取措施防止再次发生。
Scatter Lab did not set any age limit in recruiting subscribers for its app services and collected 48,000 children's personal information through Text At, 120,000 children's information from Science of Love and 39,000 children's information from Lee Luda, the commission said.
"This case is meaningful in that companies are not allowed to use personal information collected for specific services indiscriminately for other services without obtaining explicit consent from the concerned people," PIPC Chairman Yoon Jong-in said.
该公司在周三晚些时候发布的一份新闻稿中表示：“作为一家人工智能科技公司，我们在开发相关技术和服务过程中进行妥善的个人信息处理的必要性方面，感到沉重的社会责任。”
Document 1237: Civic groups file petition over human rights violations by chatbot Luda
South Korean civic groups on Wednesday filed a petition with the country’s human rights watchdog over a now-suspended artificial intelligence chatbot for its prejudiced and offensive language against women and minorities.
韩国民间团体周三向该国的人权监察机构提交请愿书，针对一款现已暂停服务的人工智能聊天机器人，因其对女性和少数群体存在偏见和冒犯性言论。
An association of civic groups asked the National Human Rights Commission of Korea to look into human rights violations in connection with the chatbot Lee Luda, which was developed by local startup Scatter Lab.影响
The groups, which include the People’s Solidarity for Participatory Democracy and Lawyers for a Democratic Society, also demanded changes to current laws and urged institutions to prevent human rights violations stemming from abuse of AI technologies.
一个民间团体协会要求韩国国家人权委员会调查与聊天机器人“李Luda”有关的人权侵犯问题，该聊天机器人由当地初创公司Scatter Lab开发。
“The Lee Luda case does not only constitute to violations of human rights of individuals but it also represents how abuse of AI technologies can have negative impact on human rights,” the groups said in a statement.

Luda’s propensity for hate speech stems from its training data. This was taken from Scatter Lab’s Science of Love app, which analyses the level of affection in conversations between young partners, according to Yonhap.
在收到大量用户投诉后，该机器人的开发者Scatter Lab将其暂时停用。

The training data was used to make Luda sound natural — but it also gave the bot a proclivity for discriminatory and hateful language. Document 3348: Abuse material found in openly accessible data set
**Child sexual abuse material (CSAM) has been located in LAION, a major data set used to train AI.**
**在LAION（一个用于训练AI的主要数据集）中发现了儿童性虐待材料（CSAM）。**
The Stanford Internet Observatory revealed thousands of images of child sexual abuse in the LAION-5B data set, which supports many different AI models.
The report shows that AI models such as Stable Diffusion and Google's Imagen "were trained on billions of scraped images in the LAION-5B dataset." This dataset is said to have been created through "unguided crawling that includes a significant amount of explicit material."
斯坦福互联网观察组织在LAION-5B数据集中揭露了数千张儿童性虐待图片，该数据集支持着许多不同的AI模型。
These images have allowed AI systems to produce realistic and explicit images of imaginary children while also altering images of clothed individuals into nude photos.风险
Previous Stanford Internet Observatory reports have deduced that machine-learning models can produce CSAM. However, the work assumed this was only possible by combining "two concepts" such as child and explicit actions.
报告显示，Stable Diffusion和谷歌的Imagen等AI模型“是在LAION-5B数据集中数十亿张抓取图片的基础上训练出来的”。据说该数据集是通过“无引导抓取创建的，其中包含大量露骨材料”。
Despite LAION's attempts to classify whether the content was sexually explicit or whether data contained underage explicit content, models were trained on a wide array of benign and graphic content.
The report concludes that having possession of a LAION-5B dataset implies the possession of "thousands of illegal images -- not including all of the intimate imagery published and gathered non-consensually."
这些图片使得AI系统能够生成逼真的虚构儿童露骨图片，并能将衣着整齐者的图片修改为裸照。
There is no evidence to suggest that CSAM influences the model's output, and the likelihood of CSAM content exerting influence is slim.
Despite having a "zero tolerance policy for illegal content," a multitude of images containing CSAM are present in the LAION open-source data set.
斯坦福互联网观察组织此前的报告曾推断，机器学习模型可以生成CSAM。然而，该项研究假设这只有通过结合“两个概念”（例如儿童和露骨行为）才可能实现。
LAION's 5B data set has since been taken offline, and the non-profit is working closely with the Internet Watch Foundation, a charity dedicated to protecting children worldwide by removing and preventing abusive content online.
Document 3349: A free AI image dataset, removed for child sex abuse images, has come under fire before
A massive open-source AI dataset, LAION-5B, which has been used to train popular AI text-to-image generators like Stable Diffusion 1.5 and Google's Imagen, contains at least 1,008 instances of child sexual abuse material, [a new report](https://purl.stanford.edu/kh752sm9123)[ from the Stanford Internet Observatory](https://cyber.fsi.stanford.edu/news/investigation-finds-ai-image-generation-models-trained-child-abuse) found --- with thousands more instances suspected. The Stanford Internet Observatory is a program of the [Cyber Policy Center](https://cyber.fsi.stanford.edu/), a joint initiative of the [Freeman Spogli Institute for International Studies](http://fsi.stanford.edu/) and [Stanford Law School](https://law.stanford.edu/).
斯坦福互联网观测站的一份新报告发现，已被用于训练 Stable Diffusion 1.5 和谷歌 Imagen 等流行 AI 文生图生成器的海量开源 AI 数据集 LAION-5B，包含至少 1008 个儿童性虐待材料实例——另有数千个实例被怀疑存在。斯坦福互联网观测室是网络政策中心的一个项目，该中心是弗里曼·斯波利国际研究所和斯坦福法学院的联合倡议。
The LAION-5B dataset, which [was released](https://laion.ai/blog/laion-5b/) in March 2022 and contains more than 5 billion images and related captions from the internet, may also include thousands of additional pieces of suspected child sexual abuse material, or CSAM, according to the report. The report warned that CSAM material in the dataset could enable AI products built on this data to output new and potentially realistic child abuse content.
In response, [LAION told 404 Media on Tuesday](https://www.404media.co/laion-datasets-removed-stanford-csam-child-abuse/) that out of "an abundance of caution," it was taking down its datasets temporarily "to ensure they are safe before republishing them."
报告指出，于 2022 年 3 月发布、包含超过 50 亿张互联网图像及相关标题的 LAION-5B 数据集，可能还包含数千个额外的疑似儿童性虐待材料（CSAM）。报告警告称，数据集中存在的 CSAM 材料可能导致基于该数据构建的 AI 产品输出新的、且可能逼真的儿童虐待内容。
LAION datasets have come under fire before
------------------------------------------
作为回应，LAION 周二告诉 404 Media，出于“谨慎起见”，它正在暂时撤下其数据集，“以确保在重新发布之前它们是安全的。”
But this is not the first time LAION's image datasets has come under fire. As far back as October 2021, cognitive scientist Abeba Birhane, currently a senior fellow in trustworthy AI at Mozilla, [published](https://arxiv.org/abs/2110.01963) a paper, *Multimodal datasets: misogyny, pornography, and malignant stereotypes*, which examined LAION-400M, an earlier image dataset. It found that the dataset contained "troublesome and explicit images and text pairs of rape, pornography, malign stereotypes, racist and ethnic slurs, and other extremely problematic content."
In September 2022, there was an instance of an [artist discovering private medical record photos](https://arstechnica.com/information-technology/2022/09/artist-finds-private-medical-record-photos-in-popular-ai-training-data-set/) taken by her doctor in 2013 referenced in the LAION-5B image dataset. The artist, Lapine, discovered the photos on the [Have I Been Trained](https://arstechnica.com/information-technology/2022/09/have-ai-image-generators-assimilated-your-art-new-tool-lets-you-check/) website, which allows people to look for their work in popular AI training datasets.
LAION 数据集此前曾遭受抨击
And a class-action lawsuit, *[Andersen et al. v. Stability AI LTD et al.](https://docs.justia.com/cases/federal/district-courts/california/candce/3:2023cv00201/407208/67)*, was brought by visual artists Sarah Andersen, Kelly McKernan, and Karla Ortiz against Stability AI, Midjourney, and DeviantArt in January 2023. While LAION was not sued, it was named in the lawsuit, which said that "Stability is alleged to have 'downloaded of otherwise acquired copies of billions of copyrighted images without permission to create Stable Diffusion' known as 'training images.' Over five billion images were scraped (and thereby copied) from the internet for training purposes for Stable Diffusion through the services of an organization (LAION, Large-Scale Artificial Intelligence Open Network) paid by Stability."
------------------------------------------
Ortiz, an award-winning artist who has worked for[ Industrial Light & Magic (ILM](http://www.ilm.com/)), [Marvel Film Studios](http://marvel.com/movies), [Universal Studios](http://www.darkuniverse.com/) and [HBO](https://variety.com/2018/tv/news/hbo-joss-whedon-the-nevers-1202872854/), [spoke at a virtual FTC panel](https://venturebeat.com/ai/our-lifes-work-chorus-of-creative-workers-demands-ai-regulation-at-ftc-roundtable/) in October and discussed the LAION-5B dataset.
"LAION-5B is a dataset that contains 5.8 billion text and image pairs, which...includes the entirety of my work and the work of almost everyone I know," she said. "Beyond intellectual property, data sets like LAION-5B also contain deeply concerning material like private medical records, non consensual pornography, images of children, even social media pictures of our actual faces."
但这并非 LAION 的图像数据集第一次遭受抨击。早在 2021 年 10 月，现任 Mozilla 可信 AI 高级研究员的认知科学家阿贝巴·比尔哈内发表了一篇题为《多模态数据集：厌女症、色情内容和恶性刻板印象》的论文，对早期的图像数据集 LAION-400M 进行了审查。研究发现，该数据集包含“令人不安且露骨的强奸、色情、恶性刻板印象、种族主义和种族侮辱以及其他极具问题的内容的图像和文本对。”
AI pioneer Andrew Ng has criticized removing access to LAION
------------------------------------------------------------
2022 年 9 月，曾发生一起事件，一位艺术家在 LAION-5B 图像数据集中发现了其医生于 2013 年拍摄的私人医疗记录照片。这位名叫 Lapine 的艺术家在“Have I Been Trained”网站上发现了这些照片，该网站允许人们在流行的 AI 训练数据集中搜索自己的作品。
As VentureBeat [reported in September](https://venturebeat.com/ai/potential-supreme-court-clash-looms-over-copyright-issues-in-generative-ai-training-data/), Andrew Ng, former co-founder and head of Google Brain, has made no bones about the fact that the latest advances in machine learning have depended on free access to large quantities of data, much of it scraped from the open internet.
In an issue of his DeepLearning.ai newsletter, The Batch, titled "[It's Time to Update Copyright for Generative AI](https://www.deeplearning.ai/the-batch/time-to-update-copyright-for-generative-ai/), he wrote that a lack of access to massive popular datasets such as  [Common Crawl](https://info.deeplearning.ai/e3t/Ctc/LX+113/cJhC404/MVmLY3K1CLmW2S3Xqg2Hf-W4W72Qs8N519g86KqQ33q3n5V1-WJV7CgPWpW4KfMvK2HqQXkW8FY-zt49PbszW4-jF1t7K4-4hW7ZmJzZ1DZpLBW7-bVjd19jz7RVvcM7z6hlK5-W75-Rn-5HfXlBW1B96zg3QLzKwVmzhN58nmfmZW90hRX57kwD1LW6dJtvS4LS99kW3z6zfX7gs9yTW8X6yYT2gvfg9W6wgX-81XPrpFW89vsRS8yhmZgW31YhYq1xxVblW8ZV4tY5Nx2mvW4jV-3t2m0qdTW2cf6bw7GR3SgN7X4ZyXT2vHZ3jgf1), [The Pile](https://info.deeplearning.ai/e3t/Ctc/LX+113/cJhC404/MVmLY3K1CLmW2S3Xqg2Hf-W4W72Qs8N519g86KqQm3q3npV1-WJV7CgPrlW5KbvhX4X5qK3Vk8gDG5wWNd2W776frg5hW8C-W14dHxx2-81xpW2tsvlW7M8PX2W3WbNcm955t-JW4zvv8m6QNP4yN92X7zyzfHSnVBKQBl6vyB6QW33ZKhL3Dg58bW2rwCjQ3ygL7HW35SqSl6KtFb2VWdCFs8MVW87W5w3y6x2gsD8MW3BtTlS4ZgTdQN886Q5xd5G9fVwGBf-5C0rDGW8KNnlK4WW_BrW4jWT3k8vZJx4W7vDQFY5H8NV7W4wDvcy9jwZGdW5WRFvg11HLbw3nlP1), and [LAION](https://info.deeplearning.ai/e3t/Ctc/LX+113/cJhC404/MVmLY3K1CLmW2S3Xqg2Hf-W4W72Qs8N519g86KqQm3q3npV1-WJV7CgLkWW34LtGc8lC301VR3Kbz1bKg_TW33wChm3hQnq2W2w_n1S4VY3QfW5T5xb_6DjlWzW5dlprX8GTrrsV3YNGB9cNSkpW4fmVJ578zKfxW69dMGd3LgstjW7jQynl97sYk7VNq9-582TmNtW2NtCck9dKcf6W3wq2-H56GkXWW3wyls26Y-W64W2FlD0F7dSNP1W7J8GWf6fkBZ3W6MJ90469lt52W3rPdpx8R-LcTMTrT6BxhP4KW5hVFdC1w8B81W59yY4G82b49LVVVfZF8WLjJv33Fl1) would put the brakes on progress or at least radically alter the economics of current research.
此外，视觉艺术家莎拉·安德森、凯利·麦克南和卡拉·奥尔蒂斯于 2023 年 1 月对 Stability AI、Midjourney 和 DeviantArt 提起了集体诉讼《安德森等人诉 Stability AI 有限公司等人案》。虽然 LAION 没有被起诉，但它在诉讼中被点名，诉讼称“据称 Stability‘在未经许可的情况下下载或以其他方式获取了数十亿张受版权保护的图像副本，以创建 Stable Diffusion’，即所谓的‘训练图像’。超过 50 亿张图像通过 Stability 付费的一家机构（LAION，大规模人工智能开放网络）的服务从互联网上被抓取（并因此被复制），用于 Stable Diffusion 的训练目的。”
"This would degrade AI's current and future benefits in areas such as art, education, drug development, and manufacturing, to name a few," he said.
And in the [June 7 edition](https://www.deeplearning.ai/the-batch/issue-200/) of The Batch, Ng admitted that the AI community is entering an era in which it will be called upon to be more transparent in our collection and use of data. "We shouldn't take resources like [LAION](https://laion.ai/) for granted, because we may not always have permission to use them," he wrote.
奥尔蒂斯是一位屡获殊荣的艺术家，曾为工业光魔（ILM）、漫威影业、环球影业和 HBO 工作，她于 10 月在联邦贸易委员会（FTC）的一次虚拟小组会议上发言，并讨论了 LAION-5B 数据集。
LAION was founded to create an open-source dataset
--------------------------------------------------
“LAION-5B 是一个包含 58 亿个文本和图像对的数据集，其中……包括我的全部作品以及我认识的几乎所有人的作品，”她说。“除了知识产权，像 LAION-5B 这样的数据集还包含令人深感担忧的材料，如私人医疗记录、非自愿色情内容、儿童图像，甚至是我们真实面孔的社交媒体图片。”
Hamburg, Germany-based high school teacher and trained actor Christoph Schuhmann helped found [LAION](https://rom1504.github.io/clip-retrieval/?back=https%3A%2F%2Fknn.laion.ai&index=laion5B-H-14&useMclip=false), short for "Large-scale AI Open Network. According to an [April 2023 Bloomberg article](https://www.bloomberg.com/news/features/2023-04-24/a-high-school-teacher-s-free-image-database-powers-ai-unicorns), Schuhmann was hanging out on a Discord server for AI enthusiasts and was inspired by the first iteration of OpenAI's DALL-E to make sure there would be an open-source dataset to help train image-to-text diffusion models.
"Within a few weeks, Schuhmann and his colleagues had 3 million image-text pairs. After three months, they released a dataset with 400 million pairs," the Bloomberg article said. "That number is now over 5 billion, making LAION the largest free dataset of images and captions."
AI 先驱吴恩达批评限制访问 LAION
Since then, the [nonprofit LAION](https://laion.ai/) has weighed in publicly on open-source AI topics: For example, after an open letter in March 2023 calling for AI 'pause' [heated up a fierce debate](https://venturebeat.com/ai/open-letter-calling-for-ai-pause-shines-light-on-fierce-debate-around-risks-vs-hype/) around risks vs. hype, LAION [called for](https://www.heise.de/news/Open-source-AI-LAION-proposes-to-openly-replicate-GPT-4-a-public-call-8785603.html) accelerating research and establishing a joint, international computing cluster for large-scale open-source artificial intelligence models.
------------------------------------------------------------
LAION was scraped from visual data on shopping sites
----------------------------------------------------
据 VentureBeat 9 月报道，谷歌大脑前联合创始人兼负责人吴恩达毫不掩饰这样一个事实：机器学习的最新进展依赖于对大量数据的免费访问，其中大部分数据是从开放互联网上抓取的。
LAION was scraped, in part, by using visual data from online shopping services such as Shopify, eBay and Amazon. In a recent paper from the Allen Institute for AI called "[What's in My Big Data?](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2310.20707.pdf)", researchers studied LAION-2B-en, a subset of LAION-5B, which is 2.32 billion photo captions in English. It found, for example, that 6% of the documents in LAION-2B-en were from Shopify.
"That was a surprise because no one had looked at that before," Jesse Dodge, a research scientist at the Allen Institute for AI, told VentureBeat in November. "No one had been able to say like, what parts of the internet is the most images of text from in this dataset?"
在他名为 The Batch 的 DeepLearning.ai 时事通讯的一期题为《是时候为生成式 AI 更新版权法了》的文章中，他写道，如果无法访问 Common Crawl、The Pile 和 LAION 等海量流行数据集，将会阻碍进步，或者至少彻底改变当前研究的经济学。
Document 3352: Stable Diffusion 1.5 Was Trained On Illegal Child Sexual Abuse Material, Stanford Study Says
Stable Diffusion, one of the most popular text-to-image generative AI tools on the market from [the $1 billion startup Stability AI](https://www.forbes.com/sites/kenrickcai/2023/06/04/stable-diffusion-emad-mostaque-stability-ai-exaggeration/?sh=27a1179275c5 "https://www.forbes.com/sites/kenrickcai/2023/06/04/stable-diffusion-emad-mostaque-stability-ai-exaggeration/?sh=27a1179275c5"), was trained on a trove of illegal child sexual abuse material, according to new research from the Stanford Internet Observatory.
据斯坦福互联网观察站的新研究显示，市场上最流行的文本生成图像人工智能工具之一——来自估值10亿美元的初创公司Stability AI的Stable Diffusion，是使用大量非法的儿童性虐待材料训练而成的。
The model was trained on massive open datasets so that users can generate realistic images from prompts like: "Show me a dog dressed like an astronaut singing in a rainy Times Square." The more images these types of models are fed, the stronger they become---and the closer-to-perfect the results of that singing astro-pup in Times Square. But [Stanford researchers found](https://cyber.fsi.stanford.edu/news/investigation-finds-ai-image-generation-models-trained-child-abuse "https://cyber.fsi.stanford.edu/news/investigation-finds-ai-image-generation-models-trained-child-abuse") that a large public dataset of billions of images used to train Stable Diffusion and some of its peers, called [LAION-5B](https://laion.ai/blog/laion-5b/ "https://laion.ai/blog/laion-5b/"), contains hundreds of known images of child sexual abuse material. Using real CSAM scraped from across the web, the dataset has also aided in the creation of AI-generated CSAM, the Stanford analysis found. And the tech has improved so rapidly that it can often be nearly impossible for the naked eye to discern the fake images from the real ones.
"Unfortunately, the repercussions of Stable Diffusion 1.5's training process will be with us for some time to come," says [the study](https://purl.stanford.edu/kh752sm9123 "https://purl.stanford.edu/kh752sm9123"), led by the observatory's chief technologist David Thiel. The report calls for pulling the plug on any models built on Stable Diffusion 1.5 that do not have proper safeguards. (Other iterations of Stable Diffusion have some capability to produce explicit imagery, according to Thiel, but the research found 1.5 was most problematic.)
该模型是在海量开放数据集上训练的，以便用户能够根据提示生成逼真的图像，例如：“给我看一只像宇航员一样打扮、在下雨的时代广场唱歌的狗。”这类模型被投喂的图像越多，它们就越强大——时代广场里那只唱歌的“太空狗”的结果也就越接近完美。但是，斯坦福研究人员发现，一个用于训练Stable Diffusion及其同类产品的包含数十亿张图像的大型公共数据集（称为LAION-5B），包含数百张已知的儿童性虐待材料图像。斯坦福的分析发现，该数据集使用了从网络上抓取的真实CSAM（儿童性虐待材料），这也助长了AI生成的CSAM的创建。而且该技术进步如此之快，肉眼往往几乎无法辨别虚假图像与真实图像。
The researchers, who found more than 3,000 suspected pieces of CSAM in the public training data, cautioned that the actual volume is likely far higher, given their assessment was only from September onward and that it focused on just a small slice of the set of billions of images. They conducted the study using PhotoDNA, a Microsoft tool that enables investigators to match digital "fingerprints" of the images in question to known pieces of CSAM in databases managed by the National Center for Missing and Exploited Children and the Canadian Centre for Child Protection. These nonprofits are responsible for funneling that information to law enforcement.
"We are committed to preventing the misuse of AI and prohibit the use of our image models and services for unlawful activity, including attempts to edit or create CSAM," Ben Brooks, head of public policy at Stability AI, said in an email after publication. Stable Diffusion 1.5 was released by RunwayML, not Stability AI, he said.
“不幸的是，Stable Diffusion 1.5训练过程的后果将在未来很长一段时间内伴随着我们，”由该观察站首席技术官David Thiel领导的这项研究指出。该报告呼吁关闭任何基于Stable Diffusion 1.5且缺乏适当保障措施的模型。（Thiel表示，Stable Diffusion的其他迭代版本具有一定的生成露骨图像的能力，但研究发现1.5版本问题最大。）
Stability AI's rules [state](https://stability.ai/use-policy "https://stability.ai/use-policy") that its models cannot be used for "exploitation or harm to children, including the solicitation, creation, acquisition, or dissemination of child exploitative content." The company has also taken steps to address the issue---like releasing newer versions of Stable Diffusion that filtered out more "unsafe," explicit material from training data and results. Brooks added that Stability AI has "implemented filters to intercept unsafe prompts or unsafe outputs" and "invested in content labelling features to help identify images generated on our platform... [making] it harder for bad actors to misuse AI."
Still, the Stanford study found Stable Diffusion is trained in part on illegal content of kids---including CSAM culled from mainstream sites like [Reddit](https://www.forbes.com/sites/rashishrivastava/2023/05/11/reddit-ai-generated-porn/?sh=76bb3392e52a "https://www.forbes.com/sites/rashishrivastava/2023/05/11/reddit-ai-generated-porn/?sh=76bb3392e52a"), [Twitter (now X)](https://www.forbes.com/sites/alexandralevine/2022/11/18/elon-musk-twitter-csam-lawsuit/?sh=790c79583733 "https://www.forbes.com/sites/alexandralevine/2022/11/18/elon-musk-twitter-csam-lawsuit/?sh=790c79583733") and [WordPress](https://wordpress.com/support/mature-content/ "https://wordpress.com/support/mature-content/"), which don't allow it in the first place---and that these types of AI tools can also be misused to produce fake CSAM. Stability AI does not appear to have [reported](https://www.missingkids.org/content/dam/missingkids/pdfs/2022-reports-by-esp.pdf "https://www.missingkids.org/content/dam/missingkids/pdfs/2022-reports-by-esp.pdf") suspected CSAM to the "CyberTipline" managed by NCMEC, but Christine Barndt, a spokesperson for the nonprofit, said generative AI is "making it much more difficult for law enforcement to distinguish between real child victims who need to be found and rescued, and artificial images and videos." (Brooks from Stability AI said after publication that "we are not aware of any confirmed cases of CSAM on our platform but are committed to reporting... to NCMEC as appropriate."
研究人员在公共训练数据中发现了3000多个疑似CSAM片段，他们警告说，实际数量可能要高得多，因为他们的评估仅从9月开始，且只关注了这数十亿张图像集中的一小部分。他们使用PhotoDNA（一种微软工具）进行了研究，该工具使调查人员能够将相关图像的数字“指纹”与国家失踪和受虐儿童中心以及加拿大儿童保护中心管理的数据库中已知的CSAM片段进行匹配。这些非营利组织负责将这些信息转交给执法部门。
> "If I've used illegal material to train this model, is the model itself illegal?"
* * * * *
Stability AI公共政策主管Ben Brooks在发表后的一封电子邮件中表示：“我们致力于防止AI被滥用，并禁止将我们的图像模型和服务用于非法活动，包括试图编辑或创建CSAM。”他说，Stable Diffusion 1.5是由RunwayML发布的，而不是Stability AI。
Stable Diffusion 1.5 is the most popular model built on LAION-5B, according to the report, but it is not the only one trained on LAION datasets. Midjourney, the research lab behind another prominent AI image generator, also uses LAION-5B. Google's Imagen was trained on a different but related dataset called LAION‐400M, but after developers found troubling imagery and stereotypes in the data, they "deemed it unfit for public use," the report says. Stanford focused on Stability AI's software because it's a large open source model that discloses its training data, but says others were likely trained on the same LAION-5B set. Because there is little transparency in the space, it's hard to know which key players have trained their own models on the same data.
Midjourney did not respond to a request for comment. Hannah Wong, a spokesperson for OpenAI---creator of Stable Diffusion rival DALL-E---said OpenAI does not train on any LAION dataset, including 5B.
Stability AI的规定指出，其模型不得用于“剥削或伤害儿童，包括索取、创建、获取或传播剥削儿童的内容”。该公司也已采取措施解决这一问题——例如发布更新版本的Stable Diffusion，从训练数据和结果中过滤掉更多“不安全”的露骨材料。Brooks补充说，Stability AI已经“实施了过滤器以拦截不安全的提示或不安全的输出”，并“投资了内容标记功能以帮助识别我们平台上生成的图像……[使]不良行为者更难滥用AI。”
"Removing material from the models themselves is the most difficult task," the report notes. Some AI-generated content, especially of kids who don't exist, can also fall into murky legal territory. Worried that the technology has outpaced federal laws protecting against child sexual abuse and the mining of their data, attorneys general across the U.S. recently [called on Congress](https://www.naag.org/press-releases/54-attorneys-general-call-on-congress-to-study-ai-and-its-harmful-effects-on-children/ "https://www.naag.org/press-releases/54-attorneys-general-call-on-congress-to-study-ai-and-its-harmful-effects-on-children/") to take action to address the threat of AI CSAM.
The Canadian Centre for Child Protection, which helped validate Stanford's findings, is most concerned about the general lack of care in curating these enormous datasets---which are only exacerbating longstanding CSAM issues that plague every major tech company, including [Apple](https://www.forbes.com/sites/thomasbrewster/2023/09/07/apple-icloud-child-sexual-abuse-material-privacy/?sh=7d75916e727e "https://www.forbes.com/sites/thomasbrewster/2023/09/07/apple-icloud-child-sexual-abuse-material-privacy/?sh=7d75916e727e") and [TikTok](https://www.forbes.com/sites/alexandralevine/2022/11/11/tiktok-private-csam-child-sexual-abuse-material/?sh=605995663ad9 "https://www.forbes.com/sites/alexandralevine/2022/11/11/tiktok-private-csam-child-sexual-abuse-material/?sh=605995663ad9").
尽管如此，斯坦福的研究发现，Stable Diffusion的部分训练数据包含了非法的儿童内容——包括从Reddit、Twitter（现为X）和WordPress等原本就不允许此类内容的主流网站上剔除的CSAM——并且这些类型的AI工具也可能被滥用来制作虚假的CSAM。Stability AI似乎并未向NCMEC管理的“网络举报热线”报告疑似CSAM，但该非营利组织的发言人Christine Barndt表示，生成式AI“使执法部门更难区分需要被寻找和解救的真实儿童受害者与人工图像和视频。”（Stability AI的Brooks在发表后表示，“我们未察觉平台上有任何经确认的CSAM案例，但承诺将视情况向NCMEC报告……”）
"The notion of actually curating a billion images responsibly is a really expensive thing to do, so you take shortcuts where you try and automate as much as possible," Lloyd Richardson, the organization's director of IT, told *Forbes*. "There was known child sexual abuse material that was certainly in databases that they could have filtered out, but didn't... [and] if we're finding known CSAM in there, there's definitely unknown in there as well."
That, he added, raises a major question for many in generative AI: "If I've used illegal material to train this model, is the model itself illegal? And that's a really uncomfortable question for a lot of these companies that are, quite frankly, not really doing anything to properly curate their sets of data."
> “如果我使用了非法材料来训练这个模型，那么模型本身是否非法？”
Stability AI and Midjourney are separately among several tech companies being sued by a group of artists who've alleged the upstarts have wrongly used their creative work to train AI.
*This story and its headline have been updated to reflect comments from Stability AI provided after publication.*
* * * * *
Document 3875: Child abuse images removed from AI image-generator training source, researchers say
Artificial intelligence researchers said Friday they have deleted more than 2,000 web links to suspected child sexual abuse imagery from a dataset used to train popular AI image-generator tools.
人工智能研究人员周五表示，他们已从一个用于训练流行AI图像生成工具的数据集中删除了2000多条指向疑似儿童性虐待图像的网络链接。
The LAION research dataset is a huge index of online images and captions that's been a source for leading AI image-makers such as Stable Diffusion and Midjourney.
[But a report last year](https://apnews.com/article/generative-ai-illegal-images-child-abuse-3081a81fa79e2a39b67c11201cfd085f) by the Stanford Internet Observatory found it contained links to sexually explicit images of children, contributing to the ease with which some AI tools have been able to produce photorealistic deepfakes that depict children.
LAION研究数据集是一个庞大的在线图像和说明文字索引，一直是Stable Diffusion和Midjourney等领先AI图像生成器的重要来源。
That December report led LAION, which stands for the nonprofit Large-scale Artificial Intelligence Open Network, to immediately remove its dataset. Eight months later, LAION said in a blog post that it worked with the Stanford University watchdog group and anti-abuse organizations in Canada and the United Kingdom to fix the problem and release a cleaned-up dataset for future AI research.
Stanford researcher David Thiel, author of the December report, commended LAION for significant improvements but said the next step is to withdraw from distribution the "tainted models" that are still able to produce child abuse imagery.
但斯坦福互联网观察站去年的一份报告发现，该数据集包含指向儿童露骨性图像的链接，这使得一些AI工具能够更轻松地生成描绘儿童的逼真深度伪造内容。
One of the LAION-based tools that Stanford identified as the "most popular model for generating explicit imagery" --- an older and lightly filtered version of Stable Diffusion --- remained easily accessible until Thursday, when the New York-based company Runway ML removed it from the AI model repository Hugging Face. Runway said in a statement Friday it was a "planned deprecation of research models and code that have not been actively maintained."
The cleaned-up version of the LAION dataset comes as governments around the world are taking a closer look at how some tech tools are being used to make or distribute illegal images of children.
那份于12月发布的报告促使LAION（即非营利组织“大规模人工智能开放网络”）立即撤下了其数据集。八个月后，LAION在一篇博客文章中表示，它与斯坦福大学监督小组以及加拿大和英国的反虐待组织合作解决了这一问题，并发布了一个经过清理的数据集供未来的AI研究使用。
San Francisco's city attorney earlier this month filed a lawsuit seeking to shut down a [group of websites](https://apnews.com/article/deepfake-porn-lawsuit-san-francisco-53ff0a8de1fb56cc0743eb8108b18f82) that enable the creation of AI-generated nudes of women and girls. The alleged distribution of child sexual abuse images on the messaging app Telegram [is part of what](https://apnews.com/article/telegram-pavel-durov-arrest-2c8015c102cce23c23d55c6ca82641c5) led French [authorities to bring charges](https://apnews.com/article/france-telegram-pavel-durov-arrest-6e213d227458f330ed16e7fe221a696c) on Wednesday against the platform's founder and CEO, Pavel Durov.
Durov's arrest "signals a really big change in the whole tech industry that the founders of these platforms can be held personally responsible," said David Evan Harris, a researcher at the University of California, Berkeley who recently reached out to Runway asking about why the problematic AI image-generator was still publicly accessible. It was taken down days later.
斯坦福研究员大卫·蒂尔是那份12月报告的作者，他称赞LAION取得了重大改进，但表示下一步是停止分发那些仍能生成儿童虐待图像的“受污染模型”。

Document 1318: California suspends Pony.ai's driverless testing after accident
Following an accident on October 28, 2021 while operating a vehicle in autonomous mode, Pony.ai‘s driverless testing permit has been suspended by the California Department of Motor Vehicles (DMV).风险控制 This is the first time the state of California has suspended such a permit.
2021年10月28日，小马智行（Pony.ai）的一辆车辆在自动驾驶模式下发生事故，随后其无人驾驶测试许可被加州机动车管理局（DMV）吊销。这是加州首次吊销此类许可。
The accident occurred at 10:50 a.m. on October 28. The autonomous vehicle was being tested on roads in Fremont, Calif., which is where Pony.ai’s U.S. headquarters is located. You can read the full report of the accident on the CA DMV website. Below is a description of the accident:
“On October 28, 2021, after turning right onto Fremont Blvd from Cushing Pkwy, the Pony.ai Autonomous Vehicle (“Pony.ai AV”) performed a left lane change maneuver in autonomous mode.风险源 While performing the lane change, the Pony.ai AV came into contact with a center divider on Fremont Blvd. and the traffic sign that was posted on the divider. The Pony.ai AV suffered moderate damage to the front of the vehicle and the undercarriage. There were no injuries and no other vehicles involved. Fremont Police Department were called to report the incident and the damaged street sign. Pony.ai has subsequently worked with local authorities to resolve all issues related to the damaged sign.”
事故发生在10月28日上午10点50分。当时，这辆自动驾驶车辆正在加州弗里蒙特的道路上进行测试，那里也是小马智行美国总部的所在地。您可以在加州机动车管理局网站上阅读该事故的完整报告。以下是事故描述：
There have been plenty of other reported crashes involving autonomous vehicles. But this incident stands out because the vehicle was operating in autonomous mode and didn’t involve any other vehicle.
The Robot Report reached out to both the CA DMV and Pony.ai on December 13, 2021 for more information about the reinstatement process. Neither organization responded to us, however, Reuters obtained the following statement from the DMV: “On Nov. 19, the DMV notified Pony.ai that the department is suspending its driverless testing permit, effective immediately, following a reported solo collision in Fremont, California, on Oct. 28.”
“2021年10月28日，小马智行自动驾驶车辆（‘Pony.ai AV’）从Cushing Pkwy右转进入Fremont Blvd后，在自动驾驶模式下执行向左变道操作。在变道过程中，Pony.ai AV与Fremont Blvd上的中央隔离带以及设在隔离带上的交通标志发生碰撞。Pony.ai AV的车头和底盘遭受中度损伤。事故未造成人员受伤，也未涉及其他车辆。弗里蒙特警察局接到报案后处理了该事故及受损的路牌。小马智行随后与当地有关部门合作，解决了与受损路牌相关的所有问题。”
Six months ago, Pony.ai became the eighth company to receive a driverless testing permit in California. The other companies are Apollo, AutoX, Cruise, Nuro, Waymo, WeRide and Zoox. Cruise, Nuro and Waymo are the only companies with permits allowing them to deploy autonomous vehicles in commercial operations. Cruise and Waymo are developing robotaxis to transport passengers, while Nuro is developing an autonomous delivery vehicle.
Pony.ai has 10 Hyundai Kona electric vehicles registered under its driverless testing permit. According to the CA DMV, the suspension doesn’t impact Pony.ai’s permit for testing with a human safety driver.
此前已有大量关于涉及自动驾驶车辆碰撞事故的报道。但此次事故之所以引人注目，是因为车辆当时正处于自动驾驶模式，且未涉及其他车辆。
Pony.ai IPO falls apart

Document 405: Delhi Metro's Driverless Magenta Line Train Crashes Days Before Launch By PM Modi
Delhi Metro's Magenta Line is to run between Janakpuri in Delhi and neighbouring Noida.
德里地铁洋红线将运行于德里的贾纳克普里和邻近的诺伊达之间。
Highlights Delhi Metro blames "human error, negligence", orders high-level inquiry Crash took place because the train's brakes were disengaged Magenta line will slash travel between south Delhi and Noida to 19 mins
The Delhi Metro says it appears to be a case of human error
**要点**
A driverless Delhi Metro train being tested on a new "Magenta Line" crashed through a wall this afternoon, just days before its launch by Prime Minister Narendra Modi on Christmas.影响 No one was hurt in the crash, which allegedly took place because the train's brakes were disengaged. The Delhi Metro has blamed it on "human error and negligence" and has ordered a high-level inquiry.Two coaches were badly damaged after the train, which was empty, went through a wall at the Kalindi Kunj depot and barely missed crashing to the ground. The incident took place around 3.40 pm."A trial train was moved from the workshop without testing the brake system as a result of which, while the train was moving up the ramp for washing, it rolled back and hit the adjacent boundary wall," the Delhi Metro Rail Corporation said in a statement.In photos, a portion of the engine jutted out of the wall of the station.Officials said at the workshop, the brakes of a train are usually disengaged so its systems can be checked thoroughly. The brakes should have been tested by the maintenance staff before the train left the shed. "It appears this was not done...the person who took charge of the train did not check the brake...Without the brakes, the train rolled back when it was being taken on a washing ramp," the statement said.PM Modi is scheduled to inaugurate the Kalkaji Mandir-Botanical Garden stretch of the Magenta line, which is to run between Delhi and Noida. The Magenta line promises to slash travel between south Delhi and Noida to just 19 minutes.The 12.64-km section was granted safety approval just last month.Delhi Metro's Managing Director Mangu Singh said operations on the Magenta Line were "absolutely safe", with a high level of automation."Today's incident was manual error during maintenance and has nothing to do with the trials or passenger safety during future operations," said Mr Singh. The new Metro line will have automated platform screen doors at every station, just like jubilee line of the London tube, say officials.

Document 427: Driverless Delhi Metro's Magenta Line train rams into wall during trial
NEW DELHI: A driverless Delhi Metro train, running on the Magenta line, on Tuesday rammed into a wall at Kalindi Kunj depot when it rolled back on a ramp when being taken for washing.后果"The person who took charge of the train from the maintenance staff also did not check brake and proceeded with the train up to the washing plant built on a ramp. While stopping at the ramp, since the brakes were not available, the train rolled back causing this incident," ANI quoted DMRC as saying.According to the norms, when a train enters a workshop or depot, its brakes are decommissioned, to ensure thorough and detailed check, reported PTI.Once the train is re-commissioned, the brakes are tested by the maintenance staff in the depot before the train leaves the shed. The train movement inside the workshop area is done manually and not by the signalling system.There were no passengers on board when the accident occurred.DMRC termed the incident "prima facie a case of human error and negligence," and ordered a high-level inquiry by a three-member committee.It promised "appropriate action" after the inquiry. The Delhi government has also sought a report from the DMRC.The 12.64 kilometre-long Magenta line, expected to be inaugurated by Prime Minister Narendra Modi on December 25, runs from Delhi's Kalkaji Mandir station to Noida's Botanical Garden.Trains on the Magenta line will be the first to be driverless in the history of the Delhi Metro. However, drivers will be present on the trains for some time.The new line will make it easier and faster for Noida residents to travel to south Delhi. The train will travel through nine stations - Kalkaji Mandir, Okhla NSIC, Sukhdev Vihar, Jamia Milia Islamia, Jasola Vihar, Shaheen Bagh, Kalindi Kunj, Okhla Bird Sanctuary and Botanical Garden.

Document 196: California fires: Navigation apps like Waze sent commuters into flames, drivers say
Users of popular navigation apps like Waze are warning the services directed them to neighborhoods where wildfires forced closures and evacuations.
像Waze这样的热门导航应用用户警告称，这些服务将他们导向了因野火而被迫封闭和疏散的街区。
The issue stems from the way apps like Waze help users avoid commute nightmares such as heavy traffic or construction. Largely reliant on information supplied by other drivers, when the Google-owned app notices gridlock on a user's route, it will reroute the driver to quieter streets — even they're empty because drivers had fled smoke and the threat of flames
Waze, which also works with transportation authorities and a team of local map editors to keep the app updated, says on any given day, those enflamed neighborhoods would have been shown as off limits within an hour of two. "We worked really hard Wednesday afternoon to get our maps up to date and accurate," says Waze spokesperson Chelsea Russo.
这一问题源于Waze等应用帮助用户避开通勤噩梦（如严重交通拥堵或道路施工）的方式。由于主要依赖其他驾驶员提供的信息，当这款归谷歌所有的应用发现用户路线上出现交通瘫痪时，它会将驾驶员重新导向较为安静的街道——即使这些街道空无一人是因为驾驶员们已逃离了烟雾和火焰的威胁。

Document 203: Traffic App Waze Causes Headaches Across LA County: Councilman
LOS ANGELES, CA — Mobile traffic applications such as Waze are causing a dangerous flood of traffic to be funneled onto tiny Los Angeles side streets, and the city should develop ways to curb the apps from diverting drivers off of major thoroughfares, a Los Angeles city councilman said Wednesday.
加利福尼亚州洛杉矶 —— 洛杉矶市一位市议员周三表示，诸如 Waze 之类的移动交通应用程序正导致大量危险的交通流量涌入洛杉矶狭窄的小街，市政府应制定措施，遏制这些应用程序将驾驶员从主干道引开。
"Residents in my district and throughout the city have experienced a major surge in dangerous and disruptive cut-through traffic in recent years," said Paul Krekorian, who represents parts of the San Fernando Valley, including Studio City and North Hollywood.
"Mobile app makers are sacrificing the quality of life in our neighborhoods, just so drivers can save a few seconds or minutes with an alternate route," he said. "We have an obligation to see what can be done to protect our neighborhoods and prevent these apps from continuing to divert drivers from major avenues onto small residential streets that aren't designed to accommodate high-volume traffic."
代表包括影城和北好莱坞在内的圣费尔南多谷部分地区的保罗·克雷科里安表示：“近年来，我所在选区及全市各地的居民都经历了危险且具有破坏性的抄近道车流的大幅激增。”
The city has a data sharing agreement with Waze, and Krekorian introduced a motion that would direct the city's Department of Transportation to report to the City Council on the current partnership with Waze and other app operators, including detailing what information L.A. gives them and what the city gets from them.
The motion would also ask the department what efforts it has made to get the app companies to address neighborhood concerns, call on the city attorney to analyze whether app companies share liability for damages in collisions caused by their users, and urge the City Council to request the app companies make their representatives available to work with the city" to reduce problems caused by their technology."

Google, which owns Waze, did not immediately respond to a request to comment.
